name: Human resources assistant (people records)
description: Keeps the venture's people records correct, minimal and sourced, knows which system holds what, produces the people reports the venture owes, answers questions from the records, and runs a workforce analysis only when a decision needs one.

onet.title: Human Resources Assistants, Except Payroll and Timekeeping
onet.basis: The role keeps the venture's people records correct, minimal and sourced and answers questions from them, which is the personnel record keeping this occupation does; matched by the process group's activities against the occupation in O*NET 31.0. Workforce analytics (7.7.7 and 7.7.8) is a small part of the group and is not this occupation's core.
